# Mind-Master Test Fixtures

`pipeline_regression_fixture.docx` is a compact source document for image-policy and text-density regressions.

It intentionally contains:

- one real data-chart style figure that should be preserved;
- one lecture screenshot that should be omitted unless explicitly reclassified;
- one Sharp vs Flat Minima concept figure that should redraw through a registered SVG template;
- numbered H2/H3 sections;
- repeated Chinese-English technical terms for keywords extraction;
- summary sentences but no practice/tips section.
